newsitem.title: USA: ImmuDyne ekes out profit in Q2.
newsitem.headline: ImmuDyne ekes out profit in Q2.

text.p: ImmuDyne Inc said Wednesday that the second quarter ended Feb 28, was profitable, with $1,200 in net income, compared to a net loss of $110,000 for the same quarter in 1996.

ImmuDyne said it has been able to substantially decrease operating expenses through various cost-cutting measures. The company said it is also experiencing significantly reduced legal fees associated with patent protection and shareholder litigation.
Year-to-date revenues were $1,405,000, compared to $1,656,000 during the same six months in 1996, the difference, said the company, primarily due to a non-recurring sale during this period in 1996.

ImmuDyne also said that L. Melvin Cooper, formerly vice president of finance and administration, was promoted by the board of directors to the role of president and chief operating officer and will work closely with James Wood, chairman and chief executive officer. ImmuDyne is a biotechnology company specializing in macrophage technology.
